item.title: Middle East Eye: Iran's president says negotiations with US are meaningless, state media reports
item.description: Iran's president says negotiations with US are meaningless, state media reports Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said negotiations with the US are meaningless, according to state media. There is no point in negotiating with "an enemy that terrorizes, sanctions, pressures, and threatens on a daily basis", he said.

item.title: Middle East Eye: Trump says rise of petrol prices no longer due to Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Trump says rise of petrol prices no longer due to Strait of Hormuz In a post on Truth Social, US President Donald Trump stated that the rise in petrol prices is no longer due to the Strait of Hormuz. Instead, Trump said that the blowing up of Russian refineries and the closing of US refineries in some states are the actual reasons behind the spike in petrol prices.

item.title: Middle East Eye: Yemen's Saudi-backed forces announce takeover of Mocha
item.description: Yemen's Saudi-backed forces announce takeover of Mocha Yemeni Saudi-backed forces have taken over Mocha city, west of Taiz province, a military source told Saba, the Yemeni news agency affiliated with government forces.

item.title: Middle East Eye: IRGC turns back tanker in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: IRGC turns back tanker in Strait of Hormuz A tanker transiting the Strait of Hormuz off the coast of Oman was turned back by Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), according to an incident report from UKMTO. The British maritime monitor said it had received a report of an incident on Monday, 11 nautical miles north of Oman, where a tanker was "hailed by the IRGC and instructed to turn back or the vessel would be targeted".
